docs.text: SaaS Boost使用与开发文档 概念解释 计算巢服务 ：云资源与软件或应用的编排集合。一旦服务被发布和上线，终端用户就可以基于这些服务创建实例，以此来获取服务提供商的具体服务内容。 计算巢服务ID ：唯一标识一个计算巢服务。 服务商 ：软件提供者，希望对软件进行商业化。 用户 ：希望使用服务商的软件的人群。 计算巢SaaS Boost ：计算巢出品的一款开源框架。计算巢提供了该框架的一键部署方案，可帮助服务商快速将其软件实现商业化。 计算巢SaaS Boost实例 ：通过计算巢一键部署方案创建的模版应用，服务商可直接访问Web界面构建其软件商城，并分享该界面给用户，实现软件的售卖。计算巢SaaS Boost实例也是通过计算巢进行部署的。 SaaS Boost商品 ：服务商通过访问其Web界面，手动生成的一个商品，该商品具有一个唯一的商品码，用于关联服务商待售卖的软件（计算巢服务）。 SaaS Boost公网访问地址 ：该SaaS Boost实例绑定的公网IP或域名，用于服务商和用户进行公网访问。也用于与计算巢进行API交互。 SaaS Boost套餐 ：每一个商品可配置不同套餐，比如低配版，基础版，高配版，每个套餐具备不同的价格。 计算巢服务套餐 ：计算巢服务侧的套餐，可对不同套餐进行参数管理。 介绍 计算巢SaaS Boost是由阿里云推出的一款开源的支付和订阅管理框架，旨在帮助软件开发者基于计算巢快速构建、部署、扩展和售卖软件（ 同时支持私有化部署和全托管模式 ）， 打通软件的商业化之路。它提供了一组开箱即用的功能和组件，使用户聚焦于业务逻辑的开发，而极大地降低软件上云应用的复杂性和成本。 计算巢SaaS Boost提供了许多功能，包括： 售卖能力：通过实现计算巢服务和SaaS Boost商品的双向绑定可快速实现软件软件售卖。支持国内支付宝支付。 计算巢能力：SaaS Boost底层为阿里云计算巢，可加速软件服务商在云上的部署、交付和管理服务, 实现一周上云。 多租户架构：SaaS Boost为多租户应用程序提供了强大的多租户数据隔离和管理功能，使得开发者可以轻松地构建和管理多个租户的数据。 持续集成和持续交付（CI/CD）能力：计算巢SaaS Boost提供了云效流水线，支持CI/CD能力，使开发者能够实现自动化的代码构建、测试和部署。可快速迭代和交付新功能，提高开发效率和产品质量。 套餐管理：SaaS Boost提供了多套餐配置，允许开发者灵活地定义和管理不同套餐，并处理套餐的计费和配额。 SaaS应用程序监控：SaaS Boost提供了监控功能，帮助开发者跟踪和分析应用程序的性能和运行状况，并及时发现和解决问题。 SaaS Boost快速部署 前提条件 使用阿里云计算巢SaaS Boost服务实例，需要对部分阿里云资源进行访问和创建操作。因此您的账号需要包含如下资源的权限。 说明 ：当您的账号是RAM账号时，才需要添加此权限。 权限策略名称 备注 AliyunECSFullAccess 管理云服务器服务（ECS）的权限 AliyunVPCFullAccess 管理专有网络（VPC）的权限 AliyunROSFullAccess 管理资源编排服务（ROS）的权限 AliyunCloudMonitorFullAccess 管理云监控（CMS）的权限 AliyunOSSFullAccess 管理对象存储服务(OSS)的权限 AliyunOOSFullAccess 管理运维编排服务(OOS)的权限 AliyunFCFullAccess 管理函数计算(FC)服务的权限 AliyunOTSFullAccess 管理表格存储服务(OTS)的权限 AliyunComputeNestSupplierFullAccess 管理计算巢服务（ComputeNest）的商家侧权限 计费说明 计算巢SaaS Boost部署涉及的费用主要涉及： 云服务器服务（ECS）费用 用于给POD分配合适的RAM角色，避免越权 镜像配置 服务端镜像 前后端一起打包的镜像。包含boost.server和bootst.front 定时任务镜像 boost.serverless ECS和ACK模式部署区别说明 ECS模式是主服务部署到一台ECS机器上，定时任务以函数计算的方式发布到阿里云FC处，该模式自带了云效流水线，服务商修改完代码后可直接实现CI/CD。 ACK模式通过Helm部署到对应的ACK集群中。不具备流水线，需要用户自己打包服务端镜像：即主服务，包含Boost.server和boost.front代码，打包Job镜像，即Boost.serverless并自己管理。 部署流程 部署计算巢SaaS Boost的流程如下： 1. 创建计算巢服务 配置您的SaaS应用（计算巢Service） ： 创建您的计算巢Service。见文档下方 Boost一键部署服务 按照提示填写部署参数 选择要部署的服务。 选择部署地域 填入支付宝沙箱信息（可跳过） 在流水线配置中，创建您的企业。根据前文fork的仓库信息创建Git连接凭证，填入前文fork的仓库地址。 创建云效企业 进入流水线 点击【全局设置】并进入 选择右上角Github服务连接并新建 Github处授权 选择付费类型和想要部署的Ecs实例规格及部署可用区 等待流水线执行完成，可按下图方式访问流水线，查看流水线执行进度 3. 流水线运行成功 5. 访问计算巢SaaS Boost服务 点击部署好的服务实例详情页的Endpoint即可访问示例SaaS Boost界面。 使用 一旦计算巢SaaS Boost部署完成（如为ECS部署方式还需等待流水线执行完成），您就可以开始使用它来开发、部署和销售您的软件应用程序。以下是一些关键的使用说明： 配置/修改服务的套餐（可选） 上传 部署物 或使用 快速ROS模版 搭建您服务的计算巢Service。 在application.properties文件中配置套餐 重新运行流水线，完成SaaS应用的部署。 支付宝沙箱测试（必选） ：在正式售卖前，请利用支付宝沙箱APP测试售卖能力。 如果在创建计算巢服务实例处选择跳过配置支付宝信息。则在使用前需要进行配置。见"对支付宝服务的配置进行修改"一节 下载官方密钥生成工具。点击生成密钥即可。 将得到的公钥上传 下载支付宝公钥 设置接口加密方式为AES 设置应用网关地址，即支付后支付宝校验的回调地址，对应服务实例详情处: AlipayNotifyUrl 设置授权回调地址，即支付后支付宝重定向的页面，对应服务实例详情处：AlipayReturnUrl 将boost.common包中激活的application-*.properties配置的沙箱支付宝网关地址修改为如图所示的正式版网关地址。将配置文件中的支付宝沙箱官方公钥替换为正式版公钥。 将您自己的应用私钥和支付宝应用公钥在OOS参数仓库进行修改。详见开发者指南-对OAuth服务的配置进行修改 重新运行流水线 进行正式支付宝的购买测试 开发者指南 Saas Boost 商品与套餐管理指南 本文档旨在指导如何在Saas Boost平台上适当地管理和定价商品，以及如何保持商品与计算巢(Calculating Nest)服务和套餐之间的一致性。 商品与服务的关联 在Saas Boost平台上创建的每个商品应对应计算巢中的单个服务。商家可基于此服务为商品设定一个基础价格。 创建商品 登录到Saas Boost。 导航至 商品管理 页面。 点击 新增商品 按钮进入创建界面。 输入服务相关信息，并在 服务ID 字段中填写对应的计算巢服务ID。 完整填写商品信息，包括名称、描述和基础定价。 点击提交，完成商品创建。 计算巢侧的套餐 此处的套餐用于管理部署的软硬件参数。 通过套餐设置功能，服务商可以将服务中的部分或全部参数配置为套餐，以供用户选择，避免用户在一个服务中配置较多参数导致的用户学习成本太高或者选配出错。 服务商可以配置多个套餐，给用户提供不同场景的最佳配置实践。 在创建服务实例时，必须选择一个套餐，再配置套餐外的参数即可创建服务实例。 更详细的信息见计算巢官方文档： 配置套餐 Saas Boost侧的套餐 此处的套餐用于管理计算巢套餐的价格。 在Saas Boost中为商品设定的每个套餐应对应计算巢中的相应服务套餐。每个套餐的名称必须与计算巢中的套餐名称完全一致。在这个过程中，开发者应该先在计算巢中进行 套餐配置 ，而后在SaaS Boost中对上述配置的套餐定制价格。 套餐命名统一 为保证用户体验的一致性，请确保计算巢中的套餐名称与Saas Boost上的套餐名称相匹配。 添加SaaS Boost套餐与定价 选择已创建好的商品，并进入其套餐管理界面。 点击 新增套餐 ，进入套餐详细配置页面。 在 套餐名 字段中准确输入计算巢中对应套餐的名称。 根据套餐配置设定一个定价。 确认信息无误后保存新套餐。 计算巢处套餐配置示例如下所示： SaaS Boost处套餐示例如下所示： 注意要点 保持Saas Boost上的套餐名称与计算巢中套餐的名称保持严格一致。 定价时要考虑对应计算巢服务套餐的具体配置。 定期审核和更新Saas Boost与计算巢之间的套餐对应关系，以保持数据的最新性和准确性。 遵循这些指导原则，商家可以保证Saas Boost平台上的商品与计算巢中服务和套餐的适当整合和价格一致性。 快速创建服务 如果您还没有为您即将售卖的软件创建计算巢服务。请基于以下文档快速创建计算巢服务。 登录到 计算巢控制台 ，选择 新建服务 2. 仿照下图配置，选择托管版服务和Spring Boot服务。 3. 填写配置参数 4. 点击"创建服务"，等待服务创建成功。 5. 后续当您想对您软件部署物进行修改时，可对该服务进行编辑，重新选择部署物。 在参数管理中修改配置参数 为了更好的售卖您的商品，您需要提前配置好个人信息管理与支付信息管理。个人信息包括服务商名称、官方链接、Logo链接和服务商简介，这些信息有助于您更好地 向用户展示您的相关情况。支付信息管理中未来会支持多种支付手段，但当前仅支持用支付宝完成收款。支付宝中您需要配置的参数包括应用ID、商户ID、官方公钥、 服务商私钥以及支付环境等五项信息。本节将详细介绍个人信息与支付信息中的参数需要填写的内容与需要遵循的规则。 修改服务商个人信息 个人信息中的Logo链接支持本地路径与http url两种方式。其他信息您可以按照您的需求进行填写。 下面是分别使用本地路径与http url的两个服务商个人信息填写示例： 示例一(本地路径)： 示例二(http url): 配置支付宝 准备阶段 在配置支付宝参数前，您需要确保您的应用已经在支付宝开放平台接入。若需注册您的应用，请访问 支付宝开发者控制台 。 若在注册过程中遇到困难，请参考支付宝开放平台的 技术接入指南 。 配置项介绍 支付宝的配置项包括应用ID、商户ID、官方公钥、 服务商私钥以及支付环境。其中，应用ID、商户ID和支付环境为普通参数，官方公钥、 服务商私钥为加密参数， saas boost利用阿里云中的oos产品保障您私密信息的信息安全。 应用ID是支付宝为每个接入其支付服务的应用或网站分配的一个唯一标识符。它用来识别具体的商户应用，确保请求来源于已授权的商家。在发起支付请求时，必须包 含此ID，以便支付宝平台能够识别并路由到正确的商户账户。 商户ID是支付宝为商户分配的一个唯一编号，用于标识商户的身份。它与应用ID相辅相成，共同确定交易的收款方。商户ID在处理支付、退款等业务逻辑时是必不可少 的，确保资金流向正确的商户账户。 官方公钥是指支付宝提供的公钥，用于验证支付宝发给商户的消息或通知的真实性。在加密通信中，商户会使用支付宝的公钥对支付宝发送过来的数据进行解密，或者验 证支付宝签名，以此确认消息未被篡改，保证了交易的安全性。 服务商私钥是指支付宝与商户约定的私钥，是RSA非对称加密体系中的一部分，与支付宝提供的公钥配对使用。商户在发起支付请求前，会使用自己的私钥对交易信息进 行签名，支付宝收到请求后，利用公钥验证签名，以此确保请求的来源是可信的。这个过程对于防止数据被篡改和保证交易的完整性至关重要。 支付环境包括沙盒环境和正式环境。沙盒环境是一个模拟的真实支付环境，供开发者在不涉及真实资金交易的情况下测试支付功能。在沙盒环境中，可以安全地调试代 码、测试支付流程，确保一切正常无误后再切换到正式环境。一旦应用的支付功能在沙盒环境中测试无误，就可以将其部署到正式环境中。正式环境直接关联实际的财务 交易，用户在这里进行的支付操作将涉及真实的货币流动。 获取方法介绍 应用ID在您的应用注册成功后，在支付宝开放平台->控制台标签页的左上角查看。如下图红框中所示。 商户ID在支付宝开放平台->右上角头像->账户中心->账号管理->账户信息->账号ID中查看。如下图红框所示。 官方公钥与服务商私钥获取方式请参考支付宝开放平台的 查看密钥/证书 文档。 支付环境请您根据自身情况设置，在沙盒环境中安全地调试代码、测试支付流程，确保一切正常无误后再切换到正式环境。 build。在build完后，Fc的jar包会上传到OSS仓库。Server的jar包会上传到计算巢制品仓库。上传之后会进行实际的部署，其中FC的部署 为直接替换OSS中zip包的方式，Server的部署为执行当前项目下的deploy.sh脚本。在熟悉了整体流水线的运行步骤后，通过结合流水线给出的错误日志，即可定位到常见的开发问题。 如果觉得在云端难以解决，可将错误环境克隆到本地。 示例如下： docs.text: 计算巢服务 ：云资源与软件或应用的编排集合。一旦服务被发布和上线，终端用户就可以基于这些服务创建实例，以此来获取服务提供商的具体服务内容。 计算巢服务ID ：唯一标识一个计算巢服务。 服务商 ：软件提供者，希望对软件进行商业化。 用户 ：希望使用服务商的软件的人群。 计算巢SaaS Boost ：计算巢出品的一款开源框架。计算巢提供了该框架的一键部署方案，可帮助服务商快速将其软件实现商业化。 计算巢SaaS Boost实例 ：通过计算巢一键部署方案创建的模版应用，服务商可直接访问Web界面构建其软件商城，并分享该界面给用户，实现软件的售卖。计算巢SaaS Boost实例也是通过计算巢进行部署的。 SaaS Boost商品 ：服务商通过访问其Web界面，手动生成的一个商品，该商品具有一个唯一的商品码，用于关联服务商待售卖的软件（计算巢服务）。 SaaS Boost公网访问地址 ：该SaaS Boost实例绑定的公网IP或域名，用于服务商和用户进行公网访问。也用于与计算巢进行API交互。 SaaS Boost套餐 ：每一个商品可配置不同套餐，比如低配版，基础版，高配版，每个套餐具备不同的价格。 计算巢服务套餐 ：计算巢服务侧的套餐，可对不同套餐进行参数管理。

docs.text: 计算巢SaaS Boost是由阿里云推出的一款开源的支付和订阅管理框架，旨在帮助软件开发者基于计算巢快速构建、部署、扩展和售卖软件（ 同时支持私有化部署和全托管模式 ）， 打通软件的商业化之路。它提供了一组开箱即用的功能和组件，使用户聚焦于业务逻辑的开发，而极大地降低软件上云应用的复杂性和成本。 计算巢SaaS Boost提供了许多功能，包括： 售卖能力：通过实现计算巢服务和SaaS Boost商品的双向绑定可快速实现软件软件售卖。支持国内支付宝支付。 计算巢能力：SaaS Boost底层为阿里云计算巢，可加速软件服务商在云上的部署、交付和管理服务, 实现一周上云。 多租户架构：SaaS Boost为多租户应用程序提供了强大的多租户数据隔离和管理功能，使得开发者可以轻松地构建和管理多个租户的数据。 持续集成和持续交付（CI/CD）能力：计算巢SaaS Boost提供了云效流水线，支持CI/CD能力，使开发者能够实现自动化的代码构建、测试和部署。可快速迭代和交付新功能，提高开发效率和产品质量。 套餐管理：SaaS Boost提供了多套餐配置，允许开发者灵活地定义和管理不同套餐，并处理套餐的计费和配额。 SaaS应用程序监控：SaaS Boost提供了监控功能，帮助开发者跟踪和分析应用程序的性能和运行状况，并及时发现和解决问题。

docs.text: 支付宝的配置项包括应用ID、商户ID、官方公钥、 服务商私钥以及支付环境。其中，应用ID、商户ID和支付环境为普通参数，官方公钥、 服务商私钥为加密参数， saas boost利用阿里云中的oos产品保障您私密信息的信息安全。 应用ID是支付宝为每个接入其支付服务的应用或网站分配的一个唯一标识符。它用来识别具体的商户应用，确保请求来源于已授权的商家。在发起支付请求时，必须包 含此ID，以便支付宝平台能够识别并路由到正确的商户账户。 商户ID是支付宝为商户分配的一个唯一编号，用于标识商户的身份。它与应用ID相辅相成，共同确定交易的收款方。商户ID在处理支付、退款等业务逻辑时是必不可少 的，确保资金流向正确的商户账户。 官方公钥是指支付宝提供的公钥，用于验证支付宝发给商户的消息或通知的真实性。在加密通信中，商户会使用支付宝的公钥对支付宝发送过来的数据进行解密，或者验 证支付宝签名，以此确认消息未被篡改，保证了交易的安全性。 服务商私钥是指支付宝与商户约定的私钥，是RSA非对称加密体系中的一部分，与支付宝提供的公钥配对使用。商户在发起支付请求前，会使用自己的私钥对交易信息进 行签名，支付宝收到请求后，利用公钥验证签名，以此确保请求的来源是可信的。这个过程对于防止数据被篡改和保证交易的完整性至关重要。 支付环境包括沙盒环境和正式环境。沙盒环境是一个模拟的真实支付环境，供开发者在不涉及真实资金交易的情况下测试支付功能。在沙盒环境中，可以安全地调试代 码、测试支付流程，确保一切正常无误后再切换到正式环境。一旦应用的支付功能在沙盒环境中测试无误，就可以将其部署到正式环境中。正式环境直接关联实际的财务 交易，用户在这里进行的支付操作将涉及真实的货币流动。

docs.text: SaaS Boost User and Developer Documentation Glossary ComputeNest Service : An orchestrated collection of cloud resources, software, or applications. Once a service is published and goes live, end users can create instances based on these services to access the specific service content provided by the service provider. ComputeNest Service ID : Uniquely identifies a ComputeNest service. Service Provider : A software provider who wishes to commercialize their software. User : The target audience who wants to use the service provider's software. ComputeNest SaaS Boost : An open-source framework developed by ComputeNest. ComputeNest provides a one-click deployment solution for this framework to help service providers quickly commercialize their software. ComputeNest SaaS Boost Instance : A template application created via the ComputeNest one-click deployment solution. Service providers can directly access the Web interface to build their software marketplace and share it with users to sell software. ComputeNest SaaS Boost instances are also deployed via ComputeNest. SaaS Boost Product : A product manually generated by the service provider through the Web interface. It has a unique product code used to associate the software (ComputeNest service) to be sold. SaaS Boost Public Access Address : The public IP or domain name bound to this SaaS Boost instance, used for public network access by both service providers and users, as well as for API interaction with ComputeNest. SaaS Boost Plan : Each product can be configured with different plans, such as Basic, Standard, and Premium, each with a different price. ComputeNest Service Plan : The plan on the ComputeNest service side, which allows parameter management for different plans. Introduction ComputeNest SaaS Boost is an open-source payment and subscription management framework launched by Alibaba Cloud. It aims to help software developers quickly build, deploy, scale, and sell software based on ComputeNest ( supporting both private deployment and fully managed mode ), opening up the path to software commercialization. It provides a set of out-of-the-box features and components that allow users to focus on business logic development while greatly reducing the complexity and cost of deploying software to the cloud. ComputeNest SaaS Boost offers many features, including: Selling Capability : Achieve rapid software sales through bidirectional binding of ComputeNest services and SaaS Boost products. Supports domestic Alipay payment. ComputeNest Capability : SaaS Boost is built on Alibaba Cloud ComputeNest, accelerating the deployment, delivery, and management of software services in the cloud, enabling cloud onboarding within a week. Multi-Tenant Architecture : SaaS Boost provides powerful multi-tenant data isolation and management capabilities for multi-tenant applications, making it easy for developers to build and manage data for multiple tenants. CI/CD Capability : ComputeNest SaaS Boost provides Cloud Flow pipelines that support CI/CD, enabling developers to automate code build, test, and deployment. This accelerates iteration and delivery of new features, improving development efficiency and product quality. Plan Management : SaaS Boost provides multi-plan configuration, allowing developers to flexibly define and manage different plans while handling billing and quotas. SaaS Application Monitoring : SaaS Boost provides monitoring capabilities to help developers track and analyze application performance and health, and promptly identify and resolve issues. SaaS Boost Quick Deployment Prerequisites Using the Alibaba Cloud ComputeNest SaaS Boost service instance requires access and creation operations on certain Alibaba Cloud resources. Therefore, your account needs the following resource permissions. Note : This permission is only required when your account is a RAM account. This mode includes a built-in Cloud Flow pipeline, allowing service providers to implement CI/CD directly after modifying code. In ACK mode, deployment is done via Helm to the corresponding ACK cluster. There is no built-in pipeline; users need to build the server image (containing Boost.server and boost.front code) and the Job image (Boost.serverless) themselves and manage them independently. Deployment Process The process for deploying ComputeNest SaaS Boost is as follows: 1. Create a ComputeNest Service Configure your SaaS application (ComputeNest Service) : Create your ComputeNest Service. See the Developer Guide - Quick Service Creation section below. For more details, see the official documentation Quick Service Creation . 2. Fork the Current Repository Fork the current repository to your personal repository. 3. Create an Alipay Sandbox Account The parameters highlighted in the guide images will be used when creating a service instance. The steps for creating an Alipay sandbox account and creating a ComputeNest service instance can be reversed. Follow the instructions in the Alipay Sandbox Documentation to create an Alipay sandbox account. The application gateway address and authorization callback address should be filled in after the service instance is created. Retain the private key of the Alipay sandbox application and the official Alipay public key. 4. Create a ComputeNest Service Instance Access the ComputeNest Console and select SaaS Boost One-Click Deployment Service . Fill in the deployment parameters as prompted: Select the service to deploy. Select the deployment region. Enter Alipay sandbox information (optional). In the pipeline configuration, create your enterprise. Create Git connection credentials based on the forked repository information and enter the forked repository address. Create a Cloud Flow enterprise. Enter the pipeline. Click Global Settings and enter it. Select GitHub Service Connection in the upper right corner and create a new one. Authorize on GitHub. Select payment type, ECS instance type, and deployment availability zone. Select/create a VPC and switch (VSW). To reduce the number of parameters to fill in, it is recommended to select "Create New". Confirm and agree to the service agreement, then click Create Now to enter the deployment phase. Wait for resource creation and pipeline execution to complete. Fill in parameters after the service instance is created (optional): Fill in AlipayNotifyUrl and AlipayReturnUrl from the deployed instance information back into the application gateway address and authorization callback address in the Alipay sandbox application configuration (Step 3.1). Wait for the pipeline to complete. You can check the pipeline execution progress as shown in the documentation. Pipeline runs successfully. 5. Access the ComputeNest SaaS Boost Service Click the Endpoint on the deployed service instance details page to access the SaaS Boost interface. Usage Once ComputeNest SaaS Boost is deployed (for ECS deployment, also wait for the pipeline to complete), you can start using it to develop, deploy, and sell your software applications. Here are some key usage instructions: Configure/modify service plans (optional): Upload deployment artifacts or use quick ROS templates to build your ComputeNest Service. Configure plans in the application.properties file. Re-run the pipeline to complete SaaS application deployment. Alipay Sandbox Testing (Required) : Before official selling, use the Alipay sandbox APP to test selling capabilities. If you skipped configuring Alipay information when creating the ComputeNest service instance, you need to configure it before use. See the section "Modifying Alipay Service Configuration". Download the Alipay client sandbox Android APP from the Alipay sandbox tools. Select the software product you want to purchase on the featured services page. Use the account and password provided in the sandbox app to test payment. View the deployed service instance details. View deployed service instance monitoring. View order history. After passing sandbox testing, be sure to test again using an official Alipay account: Access the Alipay Developer Console . Create a web/mobile application. Fill in the application name, merchant account, and icon as prompted. Configure the following parameters in order: Select interface encryption. Choose key encryption method. Download the official key generation tool. Click "Generate Key". Upload the obtained public key. Download the Alipay public key. Set the interface encryption method to AES. Set the application gateway address (Alipay's callback address after payment), corresponding to AlipayNotifyUrl in service instance details. Set the authorization callback address (the page Alipay redirects to after payment), corresponding to AlipayReturnUrl in service instance details. Change the sandbox Alipay gateway address in the activated application-*.properties in the boost.common package to the official gateway address. Replace the sandbox official Alipay public key in the config file with the official public key. Modify your application private key and Alipay application public key in the OOS parameter repository. See Developer Guide - Modifying OAuth Service Configuration. Re-run the pipeline. Conduct an official Alipay purchase test. Developer Guide SaaS Boost Product and Plan Management Guide This document guides how to properly manage and price products on the SaaS Boost platform, and how to maintain consistency between products and ComputeNest services and plans. Product and Service Association Each product created on the SaaS Boost platform should correspond to a single service in ComputeNest. Merchants can set a base price for the product based on this service. Creating a Product Log in to SaaS Boost. Navigate to the Product Management page. Click the Add Product button to enter the creation interface. Enter service-related information and fill in the corresponding ComputeNest Service ID in the Service ID field. Complete the product information, including name, description, and base pricing. Click Submit to complete product creation. ComputeNest-Side Plans Plans here are used to manage the software and hardware parameters of deployments. Through the plan configuration feature, service providers can configure some or all parameters of a service as plans for users to choose from, avoiding high learning costs or configuration errors when users configure many parameters in a single service. Service providers can configure multiple plans to provide users with the best configuration practices for different scenarios. When creating a service instance, a plan must be selected, and then the parameters outside the plan can be configured to create a service instance. For more details, see the ComputeNest official documentation: Configure Plans . SaaS Boost-Side Plans Plans here are used to manage the pricing of ComputeNest plans. Each plan set for a product in SaaS Boost should correspond to the corresponding service plan in ComputeNest. The name of each plan must be exactly the same as the plan name in ComputeNest. In this process, developers should first configure plans in ComputeNest , and then customize the price for those plans in SaaS Boost. Unified Plan Naming To ensure a consistent user experience, make sure the plan names in ComputeNest match the plan names on SaaS Boost. Adding SaaS Boost Plans and Pricing Select a created product and enter its plan management interface. Click Add Plan to enter the plan detailed configuration page. Accurately enter the corresponding plan name from ComputeNest in the Plan Name field. Set a price based on the plan configuration. Save the new plan after confirming the information is correct. Key Points to Note Keep the plan names on SaaS Boost strictly consistent with the plan names in ComputeNest. Consider the specific configuration of the corresponding ComputeNest service plan when pricing. Regularly review and update the plan correspondence between SaaS Boost and ComputeNest to maintain data currency and accuracy. By following these guidelines, merchants can ensure proper integration and price consistency between products on the SaaS Boost platform and the services and plans in ComputeNest. Quick Service Creation If you have not yet created a ComputeNest service for the software you are about to sell, please quickly create a ComputeNest service based on the following documentation. Log in to the ComputeNest Console and select New Service . Following the configuration shown, select Managed Service and Spring Boot Service. Fill in the configuration parameters. Click "Create Service" and wait for the service to be created successfully. Later, when you want to modify your software deployment artifacts, you can edit the service and reselect deployment artifacts. Modifying Configuration Parameters in Parameter Management To better sell your products, you need to configure personal information management and payment information management in advance. Personal information includes the service provider name, official link, Logo link, and service provider profile. This information helps you better showcase your details to users. Payment information management will support multiple payment methods in the future, but currently only supports Alipay for receiving payments. The parameters you need to configure in Alipay include the Application ID, Merchant ID, official public key, service provider private key, and payment environment. This section will explain in detail what content needs to be filled in for each parameter in personal information and payment information, and the rules to follow. Modifying Service Provider Personal Information The Logo link in personal information supports both local paths and HTTP URLs. Other information can be filled in according to your needs. Configuring Alipay Preparation Phase Before configuring Alipay parameters, you need to ensure your application has been connected to the Alipay Open Platform. If you need to register your application, visit the Alipay Developer Console . If you encounter difficulties during registration, refer to the Alipay Open Platform Technical Integration Guide . Configuration Items Introduction The Alipay configuration items include Application ID, Merchant ID, official public key, service provider private key, and payment environment. Among these, Application ID, Merchant ID, and payment environment are regular parameters, while the official public key and service provider private key are encrypted parameters. SaaS Boost uses Alibaba Cloud OOS to ensure the security of your private information. Application ID is a unique identifier assigned by Alipay to each application or website that integrates its payment service. It is used to identify the specific merchant application and ensure that requests come from authorized merchants. When initiating a payment request, this ID must be included so that the Alipay platform can identify and route to the correct merchant account. Merchant ID is a unique number assigned by Alipay to merchants, used to identify the merchant's identity. It works together with the Application ID to determine the payee of a transaction. The Merchant ID is essential when processing payment, refund, and other business logic, ensuring that funds flow to the correct merchant account. Official Public Key refers to the public key provided by Alipay, used to verify the authenticity of messages or notifications sent by Alipay to merchants. In encrypted communication, merchants use Alipay's public key to decrypt data sent by Alipay or verify Alipay signatures, confirming that messages have not been tampered with and ensuring transaction security. Service Provider Private Key is the private key agreed upon between Alipay and the merchant, part of the RSA asymmetric encryption system, paired with the public key provided by Alipay. Before initiating a payment request, merchants sign transaction information with their private key. Alipay verifies the signature using the public key upon receiving the request, ensuring the request comes from a trusted source. This process is crucial for preventing data tampering and ensuring transaction integrity. Payment Environment includes sandbox and production environments. The sandbox environment is a simulated real payment environment for developers to test payment functionality without real financial transactions. In the sandbox environment, you can safely debug code and test payment processes. Once the application's payment functionality has been tested without issues in the sandbox environment, you can deploy it to the production environment. The production environment is directly associated with actual financial transactions; payment operations performed here involve real monetary flows. How to Obtain the Configuration Values The Application ID can be viewed in the upper left corner of the Console tab on the Alipay Open Platform after your application is successfully registered. The Merchant ID can be viewed at Alipay Open Platform -> Avatar in the upper right corner -> Account Center -> Account Management -> Account Information -> Account ID. For obtaining the official public key and service provider private key, refer to the Alipay Open Platform documentation View Key/Certificate . Set the payment environment according to your own situation. Safely debug code and test payment processes in the sandbox environment before switching to the production environment. Scheduled Task Access SaaS Boost's scheduled tasks include closing timed-out orders, processing order refunds, and modifying the status of completed orders. For ECS deployment, access the scheduled tasks as shown in the documentation. For ACK deployment, please check the ACK Jobs. Common Errors and Solutions Pipeline Run Error The pipeline includes npm build and Java build. After the build, the FC jar package is uploaded to the OSS repository, and the server jar package is uploaded to the ComputeNest artifact repository. After uploading, actual deployment is performed: FC deployment is done by directly replacing the zip package in OSS, and server deployment is done by executing the deploy.sh script in the current project. After familiarizing yourself with the overall pipeline steps, you can identify common development issues by combining the error logs provided by the pipeline. If it is difficult to resolve in the cloud, you can clone the error environment locally. Service Instance Deployment Failure This situation is commonly caused by insufficient permissions for the user creating the service instance, or the selected ECS instance type being sold out in the current availability zone. More detailed information can be viewed in the deployment logs on the service instance details page.

docs.text: Keep the plan names on SaaS Boost strictly consistent with the plan names in ComputeNest. Consider the specific configuration of the corresponding ComputeNest service plan when pricing. Regularly review and update the plan correspondence between SaaS Boost and ComputeNest to maintain data currency and accuracy. By following these guidelines, merchants can ensure proper integration and price consistency between products on the SaaS Boost platform and the services and plans in ComputeNest.

docs.text: If you have not yet created a ComputeNest service for the software you are about to sell, please quickly create a ComputeNest service based on the following documentation. Log in to the ComputeNest Console and select New Service . Following the configuration shown, select Managed Service and Spring Boot Service. Fill in the configuration parameters. Click "Create Service" and wait for the service to be created successfully. Later, when you want to modify your software deployment artifacts, you can edit the service and reselect deployment artifacts.

docs.text: To better sell your products, you need to configure personal information management and payment information management in advance. Personal information includes the service provider name, official link, Logo link, and service provider profile. This information helps you better showcase your details to users. Payment information management will support multiple payment methods in the future, but currently only supports Alipay for receiving payments. The parameters you need to configure in Alipay include the Application ID, Merchant ID, official public key, service provider private key, and payment environment. This section will explain in detail what content needs to be filled in for each parameter in personal information and payment information, and the rules to follow.

docs.text: The Alipay configuration items include Application ID, Merchant ID, official public key, service provider private key, and payment environment. Among these, Application ID, Merchant ID, and payment environment are regular parameters, while the official public key and service provider private key are encrypted parameters. SaaS Boost uses Alibaba Cloud OOS to ensure the security of your private information. Application ID is a unique identifier assigned by Alipay to each application or website that integrates its payment service. It is used to identify the specific merchant application and ensure that requests come from authorized merchants. When initiating a payment request, this ID must be included so that the Alipay platform can identify and route to the correct merchant account. Merchant ID is a unique number assigned by Alipay to merchants, used to identify the merchant's identity. It works together with the Application ID to determine the payee of a transaction. The Merchant ID is essential when processing payment, refund, and other business logic, ensuring that funds flow to the correct merchant account. Official Public Key refers to the public key provided by Alipay, used to verify the authenticity of messages or notifications sent by Alipay to merchants. In encrypted communication, merchants use Alipay's public key to decrypt data sent by Alipay or verify Alipay signatures, confirming that messages have not been tampered with and ensuring transaction security. Service Provider Private Key is the private key agreed upon between Alipay and the merchant, part of the RSA asymmetric encryption system, paired with the public key provided by Alipay. Before initiating a payment request, merchants sign transaction information with their private key. Alipay verifies the signature using the public key upon receiving the request, ensuring the request comes from a trusted source. This process is crucial for preventing data tampering and ensuring transaction integrity. Payment Environment includes sandbox and production environments. The sandbox environment is a simulated real payment environment for developers to test payment functionality without real financial transactions. In the sandbox environment, you can safely debug code and test payment processes. Once the application's payment functionality has been tested without issues in the sandbox environment, you can deploy it to the production environment. The production environment is directly associated with actual financial transactions; payment operations performed here involve real monetary flows.

docs.text: The Application ID can be viewed in the upper left corner of the Console tab on the Alipay Open Platform after your application is successfully registered. The Merchant ID can be viewed at Alipay Open Platform -> Avatar in the upper right corner -> Account Center -> Account Management -> Account Information -> Account ID. For obtaining the official public key and service provider private key, refer to the Alipay Open Platform documentation View Key/Certificate . Set the payment environment according to your own situation. Safely debug code and test payment processes in the sandbox environment before switching to the production environment.

docs.text: Pipeline Run Error The pipeline includes npm build and Java build. After the build, the FC jar package is uploaded to the OSS repository, and the server jar package is uploaded to the ComputeNest artifact repository. After uploading, actual deployment is performed: FC deployment is done by directly replacing the zip package in OSS, and server deployment is done by executing the deploy.sh script in the current project. After familiarizing yourself with the overall pipeline steps, you can identify common development issues by combining the error logs provided by the pipeline. If it is difficult to resolve in the cloud, you can clone the error environment locally. Service Instance Deployment Failure This situation is commonly caused by insufficient permissions for the user creating the service instance, or the selected ECS instance type being sold out in the current availability zone. More detailed information can be viewed in the deployment logs on the service instance details page.
